cohort: The study included 265 singleton pregnancies of women with Type 1 Diabetes and 318,486 pregnancies of women without Type 1 Diabetes, whose pregnancies ended between 2004 and 2014.
finding: Women with Type 1 Diabetes in China experienced persistently poor pregnancy outcomes, including higher rates of maternal death, pregnancy loss, preeclampsia, neonatal death, and congenital malformations, compared to women without Type 1 Diabetes during the study period.
